review_material.assessment: The source provides a quantitative study of disorder-free localization (DFL) in a non-Abelian SU(2) lattice gauge theory. The best quantitative cluster is the entanglement entropy scaling in the SS and GI sectors at fixed mass m=1 and gauge coupling g^2=15, with fits S_SS = 2.94(2) log(t) + 1.33(3) and S_GI = 0.386(6) t + 0.43(2). This provides a numeric control (time t), two numeric readouts (entanglement entropies), quantitative mechanisms (logarithmic and linear growth), and an explicit domain (t in [2,5] from reviewer evidence). The case is authoring-ready.

review_material.paper_scope: The paper investigates dynamical phases of a (1+1)D truncated SU(2) lattice gauge theory with dynamical matter, focusing on disorder-free localization (DFL), Hilbert space fragmentation (HSF), and ergodic behavior. It uses exact diagonalization on an N=8 site chain with periodic boundary conditions, and studies matter imbalance, quark populations, and entanglement entropy scaling.
